subtitle.ko: 양쪽을 같은 수로 나눠 더 쉬운 문제로
subtitle.en: Divide both sides by the same number to make it easier

rule.ko: 피제수와 제수를 같은 공통 인수로 나누면 몫이 같은 더 쉬운 나눗셈이 됩니다.
rule.en: Divide the dividend and divisor by the same common factor to get an easier equivalent division with the same quotient.

intro.en: Hard divisions get easier when you simplify.
Find a common factor of both numbers.

intro.ko: 양쪽을 같은 인수로 줄인 뒤 몫을 구해요.
intro.en: Reduce both sides by the same factor, then find the quotient.

point.en: Find a common factor of both.

teach.ko: 양쪽을 같은 인수로 나눠 동치인 나눗셈으로 바꿔요. 첫 칸을 보여줄게요.
teach.en: Divide both by the same factor to make an equivalent division. I'll show the first cell.

bottomOut.en: Here's the simplified division and its answer.
